title: Praise be to Allah who gave us life
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaahi lladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa'ilayhin-nushoor
translation: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the rising.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6312: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9463
